LanguageData.CC_Danger_NoPropStuff: The colony has nothing to make a prop of, or can't build one yet.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_NoPropRoom: There's no room beside the face for a prop.
LanguageData.CC_Impact_DigProp: A prop of {0} marked beside the face for the builders, and the digging there marked again
LanguageData.CC_Impact_DigOn: The digging at that face marked again as it was
LanguageData.CC_Impact_DigRisk: The rock may come down on whoever digs there next: a crush, never more
LanguageData.CC_Impact_DigRiskBrief: the rock may fall on the digger
LanguageData.CC_Impact_DigLeave: That face left as it is: nobody digs there
LanguageData.CC_Danger_Rockfall: The rock came down at the dig, and caught {PAWN_nameDef} on the {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_Rockfall_2: A slab fell from the roof at the face {PAWN_nameDef} was digging, and crushed {PAWN_possessive} {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_RockfallClear: The rock came down at the dig, and {PAWN_nameDef} jumped clear of it.
LanguageData.CC_Impact_FellTree: The {0} marked to be felled, safely, by the cutters; its wood the colony's
LanguageData.CC_Impact_TreeMayFall: A wind may bring the {0} down onto the wall, which it would break
LanguageData.CC_Impact_TreeMayFallBrief: it may fall on the wall
LanguageData.CC_Impact_TreeRisk: Anyone beside it when it falls may be crushed: never more
LanguageData.CC_Danger_TreeFell: The wind brought the leaning {TREE} down across the colony's wall.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_TreeFell_2: The leaning {TREE} came down in the wind and broke the wall it leaned on.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_TreeCrush: The leaning tree came down, and caught {PAWN_nameDef} on the {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_TreeCrush_2: When the tree fell, {PAWN_nameDef} couldn't get clear, and it crushed {PAWN_possessive} {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_Impact_Stamp: {0} goes out to stamp the smoulder out before it catches
LanguageData.CC_Impact_StampRisk: Whoever stamps it out may burn a hand or a foot
LanguageData.CC_Impact_SmoulderCatches: Within a few hours it catches: a grass fire of the game's own, spreading through the dry grass
LanguageData.CC_Impact_FireRisk: A fire burns whoever fights it carelessly, as the game has it
LanguageData.CC_Impact_FireRiskBrief: the fire may burn the firefighters
LanguageData.CC_Danger_SmoulderOut: {PAWN_nameDef} stamped out the smoulder in the dry grass.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_SmoulderCaught: The smoulder in the dry grass has caught: there's fire out past the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_SmoulderCaught_2: Nobody stamped it out in time, and the dry grass past the colony is burning.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_StampBurn: {PAWN_nameDef} stamped out the smoulder, and it flared and burned {PAWN_possessive} {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_StampBurn_2: The smoulder is out, and {PAWN_nameDef} has a burned {PART} to show for it.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_NoMortar: The colony has no mortar to fire it from.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_NoFarCell: There's nowhere far enough from the colony to set it down.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_NoStandOff: There's nowhere clear to stand well back from it.
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ShellCarry: Carried far past the fields and set down there, kept from the haulers
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ShellStill: A fire that reaches it sets it off wherever it lies, as the game has it
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ShellStillBrief: a fire would set it off
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ShellBlast: {0} sets it off from well back once nobody is near: the blast tears up the field around it
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ShellBlastBrief: the shell set off in the field
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ShellRisk: A stone thrown up by the blast may cut {0}
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ShellRiskBrief: a cut from the blast, maybe
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ShellStores: To the stores for the colony's mortars
LanguageData.CC_Danger_ShellCarried: The old shell is set down far past the fields, for nobody to touch.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_BlastStone: The old shell went up in the field, and a stone from the blast cut {PAWN_nameDef}'s {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_BlastStone_2: {PAWN_nameDef} set the old shell off, and the blast threw a stone that opened {PAWN_possessive} {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ScrapBreak: {0} breaks it up where it lies: steel and bits for the colony
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ScrapRisk: The last of its charge may burn {0}
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ScrapLeft: For some days, the first who handles it may be burned by its charge
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ScrapLeftBrief: whoever handles it may be burned
LanguageData.CC_Danger_ScrapBroken: {PAWN_nameDef} has broken up the twitching scrap for its metal.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_ScrapBurn: The last of the scrap's charge jumped into {PAWN_nameDef}'s {PART}, and burned it.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_ScrapBurn_2: The old scrap spat a spark as {PAWN_nameDef} took hold of it, and burned {PAWN_possessive} {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_NoFloor: The colony can't build a floor over it, or hasn't the stuff for one.
LanguageData.CC_Impact_LayFloor: A {0} floor marked over the soft ground, for the builders to lay; the ground holds under it
LanguageData.CC_Impact_LayFloorBrief: a floor over the soft ground
LanguageData.CC_Impact_GroundRisk: The ground may give under the next who cross it: a bruise, or a crack on a foot bone, never more
LanguageData.CC_Impact_GroundRiskBrief: a foot may go through it
LanguageData.CC_Danger_GroundGave: The soft ground by the door gave under {PAWN_nameDef}, and bruised {PAWN_possessive} {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_GroundGave_2: {PAWN_nameDef}'s foot went through the soft ground by the door: a bruised {PART}, and mud where the ground was.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_GroundCrack: The ground by the door gave under {PAWN_nameDef}, and cracked a bone in {PAWN_possessive} {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_GroundCrack_2: {PAWN_nameDef} went through the soft ground by the door and came up with a cracked {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_Danger_GroundCaught: The ground by the door gave under {PAWN_nameDef}, who caught {PAWN_objective}self. It's mud there now.
